people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Ammihud
people.line: Father of Talmai, king of Geshur

people.name: Geshur
people.line: Aramean kingdom; Talmai's domain; refuge for Absalom

people.name: Talmai
people.line: King of Geshur; father of David's wife Maacah

translations.web: But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai the son of Ammihur, king of Geshur. David mourned for his son every day.
translations.bsb: Now Absalom fled and went to Talmai son of Ammihud, the king of Geshur. But David mourned for his son every day.
